blocks.html: An audit log to record. The ID is always generated by the Audit Module.

types.name: action
types.description: The name of the action, such as `order.cancel`.

types.name: actor_type
types.description: The type of actor that performed the action.

types.name: actor_id
types.description: The ID of the user, API key, or customer that performed the action.

types.name: impersonator_id
types.description: The ID of the Medusa staff member acting as the actor, on Medusa Cloud.

types.name: resource_type
types.description: The type of resource acted on, such as `order`.

types.name: resource_id
types.description: The ID of the resource acted on.

types.name: started_at
types.description: When the action started, as a `Date` or an ISO 8601 string.

types.name: ended_at
types.description: When the action ended, as a `Date` or an ISO 8601 string.

types.name: request
types.description: The HTTP details. Leave empty for an audit log written outside an API request.

children.name: path
children.description: The request path without the query string.

children.name: request_id
children.description: The request ID, the same one that appears in the application logs.

types.name: request_data
types.description: The request fields to keep. Never pass a whole request body.

types.name: response_data
types.description: The response fields to keep. Never pass a whole response body.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Any other data to attach to the audit log.
